remediation: LTO+strip are already set in [profile.release] and cannot shrink this binary: the payload is const data tables, not code or symbols. Measured drivers (issue #63/#191): (1) DOMINANT ~ tree-sitter grammar parse tables in libcbm.a - 160 grammar_*.c shims compiling vendored/grammars/*/parser.c (~1.19 GiB of C source; lean 104 MiB, systemverilog 62 MiB); reduce by compiling a curated grammar subset via a patches/cbm C-overlay that stubs non-core tree_sitter_* symbols in lang_specs.c and drops their parser.c from GRAMMAR_SRCS in patches/cbm/Makefile.cbm, gated by a cbm-sys Cargo feature, with the language registry failing closed on an absent grammar. (2) SECONDARY ~ the reachable ML stack pulled by vendored calyx-registry (candle-core/candle-nn/candle-transformers statically compiled Rust) and calyx-ward + calyx-registry (fastembed, tokenizers[onig]); ort is load-dynamic so it does NOT embed the ONNX runtime and is minor. The ML stack is vendored-Rust and has no in-repo feature-gate mechanism (Cargo features are additive; patches/cbm is C-only) - it requires an upstream Calyx feature-split + VENDORED.md pin bump. Note: astrolabe-panel's nomic code_vectors.bin is loaded at runtime via fs::read, not include_bytes!, so it contributes 0 bytes to the binary. Publish a component size breakdown (cargo bloat / bloaty) before changing this threshold.
